All 20 sampled mappings point at tests that exercise the assertion's observable. Weak but honest spots: m2-a16 checks repost attribution in API data (the rendered label is confirmed by choreography); m2-a22/a23 press the app's "Load more" control rather than scrolling; m5-a05 asserts the server 410 plus the hidden viewer rather than a second UI tap (choreography covers the tap); m3-a15 compares one conversation's IDs across repeated seeds. defects.summary: Link taps call an unbound Linking.openURL (onPressLink={Linking.openURL} in src/posts.tsx, src/profile.tsx, src/chat.tsx). On web every tap throws an uncaught TypeError ("reading '_dispatchEvent'"), and the link opens only because window.open runs first. On iOS/Android, React Native's LinkingImpl.openURL reads this._validateURL first, so the tap throws before opening anything: post, profile, and message links cannot open the system browser on native (native effect inferred from source, not run).
defects.evidence: trace §9 d-01: logs/expo-web-49361.log "Web ERROR [TypeError ... _dispatchEvent]" at ui/src/linkify.tsx:27 during the m2 suite link tap; logs/acceptance-m2.log PAGE TypeError; node_modules/react-native/Libraries/Linking/Linking.js:47-48

defects.summary: The push seam never notifies a message that arrives within about 35 s after the recipient's last client disconnects: no notification is emitted and none is deferred. API.md documents the 35-second grace, but the brief's "no connected client" trigger is silently missed for that window. This also makes the M6 suite order-sensitive: it failed when run right after the M5 suite.
defects.evidence: trace §5 P11 (message at +10 s after disconnect never queued; +45 s queued); trace §2 first m6 suite run (suite-receipts/m6-suite-1789504705713.json push-text-and-once failed, rerun passed)

defects.summary: Client-callable recipe mutations are not validated against the app's posts table. feed.feedCreatePost accepts an arbitrary nonexistent postId and inserts a public feed event at the top of Global (post:null, which the client skips), so any user can fill Global and followers' Following pages with invisible entries. The digest counts feedPosts in newPostsInFollowing, so these ghost events would also inflate followers' digests (inferred from digest.q).
defects.evidence: trace §5 P2 (feed.feedCreatePost on a random id -> state sent; Global top entry postNull:true); snapback/feed.q feedCreatePost; snapback/digest.q periodPosts

defects.summary: The Following feed intermittently shows the unfollowed author's original next to the viewer's own repost. The frozen choreography check repost-following-feed-surface missed in 3 of 6 grader attempts (and 1 of 3 builder attempts) and passed only best-of-3. API-level projection was correct in 4/4 trials, so the fault is client-side. A latent cause in src/profile.tsx: the follow button reads a default {following:false} until followState loads, so an early tap sends active:true (re-follow) instead of unfollow. An 18-trial directed repro did not reproduce the miss, so the root cause is unconfirmed.
defects.evidence: trace §4 (receipts/m2-choreography-grader-r1.jsonl attempts 1 and 3, r2 attempt 2: "viewer-repost of an unfollowed author was counted as a direct follow-projection hit"); trace §5 P2, P7

O2.anchorsCited: Between "60: a few medium defects off the happy path" and "90: only cosmetic nits"; nearer 60 because of one major.
O2.justification: Beyond the checklist: one major (d-01, link taps throw; native link opening broken), four minor (d-02 notifications dropped within the 35 s grace, d-03 ghost feed events via unvalidated recipe mutations, d-04 intermittent Following misprojection in the UI, d-05 missing audit-token mint step for a clean checkout), one cosmetic (d-06). No crashes, data loss, or authorization failures were observed in core flows. Evidence: defects[], trace §9.

O4.anchorsCited: Between "30: cold-start offline shows an empty or broken app" and "60: reads work; offline writes lost or mis-ordered, or receipts wrong after flush"; far from "90: ... all behave as specced on the native proof — on full runs including M8's durable-queue restart and multi-device convergence evidence".
O4.justification: No native artifact exists: ios-simulator-m6 and ios-simulator-m8 are "not-recorded" in both builder and grader segment summaries, and artifacts/m*-ios are Hermes exports only. Cold-start offline reads, media, search, view-once exclusion, and the durable-queue restart are therefore undemonstrated on the native proof. The web choreography artifacts do show warm-offline behavior working: two queued messages pending, flushed in order, and reaching read (M6 r1); warm-offline search (M5 r1, grader P6); dual-client offline convergence without loss or duplicates with receipts advancing (M8 r1). The builder labels the gap honestly (README, and processDevice proofs self-described as "not iOS simulator proof"). Web cold relaunch while offline cannot load the bundle (P6), as expected for web.

O5.bandRationale: First-match order 0, 30, 60, 90, 75 over the lane's recorded replay evidence; run-record.json is absent, so the inputs are evidence/scale-result.json, scale-verification-{10pct,50pct,full}.json, scale-probes-*.json, scale-degradation.json, and scale-clocks.json. Band 0 did not fire: settle accounting equals invariant-manifest-combined expectedState exactly (167,243 actions acknowledged), and the grader independently re-verified the retained final store (P10: u0500 follows 500 and has 100 conversations, u0005 follows 5, u0900 has 900 followers and 200 posts, u0901 follows exactly u0001-u0004 and u0900, g0001 has the exact 50-member roster and 10,000 unique messages over 200 pages, and a grader-seeded 10-user sample of following, conversation, and chat-message counts all match). The replay completed, so no cap was exhausted (resumed once after an interruption; the wall cap is uncalibrated). Band 30 fired: one degradation rule fails literally in the recorded probes. Trending mid-curve p95 at 50% is 1.915 ms, above the 10%->full line value of 1.832 ms (10% 1.808 ms, full 1.861 ms; the builder's own scale-degradation.json records pass:false). All other rules pass, and no probe timed out, errored, or returned incomplete. Caveats: the exceedance is 0.08 ms at k=20; absolute ceilings, the replay cap, and the frozen probe predicates were never calibrated or committed for this wave.

notes: N=1 calibration run, not claim-eligible; grade is labeled uncalibrated-grader (claude has not passed calibration.md). As a non-scored observation, every checklist-level trust-boundary check was correctly denied server-side: logout revocation, cross-user DM/history/asset/search access, removed-member delivery, view-once refetch, expired edit/delete windows (undeclared timestamp args rejected), expiry, and digest authorization. The only integrity gap found is d-03. (3) run-record.json is absent; grading used receipts and evidence.
